reviews_captured_by_me.text: Russ at Compass Bath and Remodel did a fantastic job working with us on my dad's master bath remodel. He made a 70s era shag carpet disaster with a rotting subfloor and a dropped ceiling into a royal jewel of a space. He was communicative, letting us know what to expect in the upcoming week, responsive to our questions, patient with our unique situation, and up to the task of coming up with creative solutions to what became a bespoke situation. I would definitely recommend Russ and team.

I stumbled on Compass Bath and Remodel quite by accident, and I’m glad I did. Russ Nay and his associates did a tremendous job remodeling my master bath. I got a great impression of Russ from the start. He was quick to respond, showed up in person to survey the job, listened intently to my ideas, offered up some of his own, and had a draft plan and estimate ready the next day. He has an eye for detail, and didn’t miss a thing. Russ was flexible and adaptable, and each step in the process was well coordinated. He and all of his associates were very personable and professional. I actually enjoyed watching the process; it was a great experience. I’ll be keeping his contact info readily available so I can call him again for future projects.

Compass Bath and Remodel did our recent bathroom remodel. My wife and I are very happy with the results. Russ and the rest of his crew were awesome! The communication with us before the remodel started until the completion of the project was great. It was obvious he cared about us being satisfied with the work and time frame in which it would be completed. We would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a remodel.
